data: What is the approximate value of the green line in the Phone category when the fraction of events seen is 0.8?

The green line represents the performance of the approach (TP+LP)/2. The Phone category is the second subfigure from the left. When the fraction of events seen is approximately 0.8, the green line appears to be around 75%. Therefore, the approximate value of the green line in the Phone category when the fraction of events seen is 0.8 is 75%.
